_doc: Slide-2 exec-summary / thesis. DISTILLED from the partner proposal; proposal is source of truth.
positioning: the European demand platform, now on the water
thesis: Bolt owns the demand from the Aegean to the Gulf. The coastline is the surface it hasn't claimed yet.
the_deal: We add a Bolt-branded foiling water tier across Bolt's most water-bound markets — the Greek islands, the Dalmatian coast, the Italian Riviera and lagoon, the Côte d'Azur, and the Gulf.

your_world.label: Where you are today
your_world.text: Bolt is Europe's homegrown super-app — ride-hailing, scooters and delivery across 45+ countries.

your_world.label: What you're up against
your_world.text: Ground ride-hail is margin-squeezed; your biggest peaks happen exactly where roads run out.

your_world.label: Where Navier fits
your_world.text: Bolt already owns the demand in Europe's most water-bound markets.

your_world.label: Why now
your_world.text: Peak demand hits water-bound markets as emissions rules tighten and Navier scales in the Maldives.

proof_strip.label: Markets here
proof_strip.sub: Greece · Croatia · Italy · Riviera · UAE · Saudi
